GIN.note: The document covers an agricultural land cadastre, not addressing.

facts.fact: Guinea's government launched mapping of State agricultural land in Boke, Conakry, Kankan and Kindia on 6 October 2025, feeding a national database connected to the future e-Foncier rural platform, with a dematerialised agricultural land cadastre named as a component of the reform (Agronews Guinee).
